content: Took the 7:10 train up to Grindelwald, fog until noon. It thinned slowly from about eleven, gone by noon. Hiked to Bachalpsee, the lake was completely still, saw two ibex near the path. Lunch was a sandwich from the bakery in the village, 9 francs. Legs finished by 4pm, took the gondola down instead of walking.
